newsitem.title: USA: China Energy Resources gets AMEX listing.
newsitem.headline: China Energy Resources gets AMEX listing.

text.p: China Energy Resources Corp Monday said its common shares began trading on the American Stock Exchange this morning.

China Energy Resources is a British Virgin Islands holding company which, through a wholly owned subsidiary, owns an 80 percent interest in Mishan Hua Xing Coke Ltd, a foreign equity joint venture company organized in the People's Republic of China.
A Chinese government entity has owned the remaining interest in the joint venture since it began in October 1995. The venture has a 30-year term.
The joint venture produces metallurgical coke and steam coal and is developing its capabilities to produce foundry coke.
China Energy Resources expects to announce its 1996 fiscal results on or before June 30.
